review_evidence: QuasiBorelSpaces/Defs.lean, Basic.lean, Hom.lean, Functor.lean, and OmegaQuasiBorelSpace.lean define the central reusable interfaces.
MeasureTheory/* and ProbabilityMeasure.lean/PreProbabilityMeasure.lean contain substantive probability and measure formalization.
List/Encoding.lean, Rose/Encoding.lean, OmegaCompletePartialOrder/*, and the small instance/support modules are part of the reusable formal dependency graph.
summary: Reviewed the complete quasi-borel-spaces unit. The 55 primary Lean files are a connected formal development of quasi-Borel spaces, probability measures, omega-CPO structure, encodings, and related instances; none is a lossless hard-exclusion target.
